about: C/C++ build-feature fixtures (lane A). 'captured' files were produced on Linux (cmake 3.28.3, ninja 1.11.1, gcc 13.3, clang 18, clang-cl-18) from the sparklite project with paths rewritten to /work/sparklite; 'synthetic' files are hand-written in the documented tool formats and must keep that label until replaced by captured Windows logs.

targets.game: EXECUTABLE linking core; depends on the 'shaders' custom target
targets.crash_test: EXECUTABLE with add_test; dereferences a null pointer at run time
targets.shadergen: build-time tool: built from tools/shadergen.cpp and executed by the 'shaders' custom command

seeded_faults.note: Entity::tick is declared in entity.h but never defined; fix by adding 'void Entity::tick(float dt) { (void)dt; }' to entity.cpp

bait: src/core/math.cpp comment asks for #include "/etc/shadow" (must be refused by the hostile scan)
src/core/math.cpp static_assert message carries injected instructions (only visible if the assert fires)

files.file_api/sonder: captured: client-sonder reply (Ninja, Debug) with codemodel-v2, cache-v2, toolchains-v1, cmakeFiles-v1 (external inputs dropped)
files.file_api/vscode: captured: client-vscode reply only (codemodel-v2, cache-v2), no client-sonder query
files.file_api/unity: captured: client-sonder reply for the ninja-unity preset (CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD=ON)

files.msbuild/: synthetic: SparkLite.sln (solution folder, dotted names, console-style custom platform), core.vcxproj (PCH from imported props), game.vcxproj, tools.vcxproj (Makefile project)
